text: WireGuard has no cryptographic agility — one cipher suite, no negotiation. Why is that a design strength?
choices: Nothing to downgrade and nothing to misconfigure: configurability is an attack surface, and every negotiable parameter can be negotiated badly
explanation: About 4,000 lines of code against hundreds of thousands for IPsec/IKE — small enough to audit, and it has been. If a primitive is broken, the protocol version changes rather than the configuration.
